title: Ted Baker Fusion Electric Hair & Body Wash 250ml
seo: Ted Baker Fusion Electric Hair & Body Wash 250ml
Ted Baker Fusion Electric Hair & Body Wash 250ml: spicy cinnamon and grapefruit over sandalwood. Free UK delivery over £40.
desc:
A bold, energising 2-in-1 wash for hair and body.

Ted Baker Fusion Electric Hair & Body Wash 250ml cleanses skin and hair in one easy step. Spicy cinnamon, nutmeg and grapefruit open brightly, a heart of lavender, liquorice and amber follows, and it settles on sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver. Lactic acid and mulberry leaf extract help leave skin feeling fresh.

Scent

  • Top: Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Grapefruit
  • Heart: Lavender, Liquorice, Amber
  • Base: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver

Key ingredients

  • Lactic acid
  • Mulberry leaf extract (Morus alba), an antioxidant

How to use

  • Apply to wet skin and hair
  • Massage into a lather, then rinse thoroughly
  • Avoid contact with the eyes

Good to know

  • Vegan friendly
  • Part of the Ted Baker Fusion collection

Key details

  • Brand: Ted Baker
  • Range: Fusion
  • Type: Hair & body wash
  • Scent profile: Spicy · Citrus · Woody
  • Size: 250ml

Why you'll love it

  • One wash for hair and body
  • Spicy, citrusy and woody scent
  • With lactic acid and mulberry leaf extract
  • Vegan friendly

FAQ

What does it smell like?

Cinnamon, nutmeg and grapefruit with lavender and liquorice over sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is part of the Ted Baker Fusion men's range.
note: Facts confirmed by 2+ sources (Superdrug EAN page, Next product page and ingredient PDF, Cosmetify; KMI Brands for the range). Notes agreed by Superdrug, Next and Cosmetify. Vegan friendly from Cosmetify and KMI Brands. Supplier's 'Body & Hair Wash' shown as retailers' 'Hair & Body Wash'. Awaiting photos.
